high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie in a bathroom mirror. The individual is standing in front of a sink with a modern faucet. They are wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and appear to be holding a smartphone in their hands, which they are using to take the photo. The person has short dark hair and a beard. The bathroom features a tiled wall with a mosaic pattern in shades of gray and beige. There is a shower area with a white curtain partially drawn to the side. Above the shower, there is a recessed light fixture in the ceiling. To the left of the shower, there is a vent on the wall
